description: This file defines and manages registration functions for custom operators in PyTorch, including creating, implementing, abstracting, saving for backward, and backward functions for custom ops.

methods.name: custom_op
methods.description: Registers a new custom operator, can be used as a decorator or direct call, infers schema if not provided.

methods.name: impl
methods.description: Registers an implementation for a specific device type for a custom op, can be used as a decorator.

methods.name: impl_abstract
methods.description: Registers an abstract implementation for a custom operator, defining behavior on tensors with no data.

methods.name: impl_save_for_backward
methods.description: Registers a function to specify what to save for backward pass.

methods.name: impl_backward
methods.description: Registers a backward formula for an operator, defining gradient computation.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: De-registers a custom op, for testing purposes.
